question: What will be the closing value of Apple (AAPL) stock (AAPL on Yahoo Finance) on September 17, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of AAPL on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-17. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.

research:
I've finished searching and am now writing up the findings. I left out every source dated after 2026-09-10.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-09-09: Yahoo Finance shows AAPL's last close at **$315.34** (from the code baseline). Bloomberg, as reported by Oneindia, gives the same close and a fall of 1.53% that day. [Oneindia](https://www.oneindia.com/business/apple-shares-slip-after-iphone-18-pro-foldable-iphone-launch-8201077.html)
- Other sources disagree. A table on investsmart lists the 9 Sep close as 316.31 (-0.29%), Traders Union gives $316.23, and Equentis, citing Reuters, says the stock closed about 0.3% lower. Yahoo is the resolution source, so use $315.34. [investsmart](https://www.investsmart.com.au/security/nasdaq/aapl/apple/share-price), [Traders Union](https://tradersunion.com/news/stocks/show/3277878-apple-slips-0-04percent-to-usd316-23/), [Equentis](https://www.equentis.com/blog/apple-shares-slip-after-iphone-18-pro-foldable-launch-what-investors-should-know/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. It resolves five trading sessions after the last known close.
- 2026-09-10: The Globe and Mail said AAPL was edging up in early premarket trading. A BingX headline claims the stock was "up 3.56% today, Sep 10", which would put it around $326. I couldn't open that page or confirm the number anywhere else, so treat it as unconfirmed. [Globe and Mail](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/stocks/AAPL/pressreleases/4557478/apple-unveils-foldable-iphone-but-stocks-muted-reaction-raises-questions/), [BingX](https://bingx.com/en/news/post/why-is-apple-aapl-stock-price-up-today-sep-iphone-pro-lineup-and-foldable-iphone-duo-fuel-rally)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-10: BofA kept its Buy rating but lowered its price target from $370 to $380... correction: from $380 to $370, citing margin pressure from higher memory and component costs. [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/aapl/forecast)
- 2026-09-09: At the "Surprise and shine" event Apple announced the iPhone 18 Pro ($1,199) and Pro Max ($1,299), both $100 more than last year, plus a foldable "iPhone Duo" ($1,999, on sale 23 Oct), new Apple Watches and AirPods. The stock fell during the keynote, and analysts said the products were largely priced in already. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/09/apple-event-today-live-updates.html), [Businessday](https://businessday.ng/technology/article/apple-shares-slip-after-iphone-18-launch-as-investors-weigh-ai-foldable-strategy/)
- 2026-09-01: John Ternus took over as CEO from Tim Cook. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/26/apple-iphone-launch-date-john-ternus.html)
- 2026-09-04: The stock fell about 2.5% that Friday to roughly $319.98. [Vantage](https://www.vantagemarkets.com/market-analysis/aapl-stock-price-today-iphone-launch-analyst-reaction-september-7-2026/)
- Before the event: AAPL was up about 16% for the year but roughly 8% below its July all-time high. One unverified source puts the 52-week high at about $344.57. [Oneindia](https://www.oneindia.com/business/apple-shares-slip-after-iphone-18-pro-foldable-iphone-launch-8201077.html)

## 4. Base rates
- The code baseline, built from 5-session returns over the last 3 years, gives: p5 298.7, p10 302.2, p25 309.8, p50 317.5, p75 324.6, p90 331.0, p95 335.7. That implies a 1-sigma move of about ±3% over a week.
- History: AAPL usually drifts lower or stays flat around iPhone events ("sell the news"). Moves in the week after preorders open have been mixed. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/how-apple-stock-usually-reacts-to-big-iphone-reveal-events-152915777.html), [ECM Source](https://ecmsource.com/apple-sept-9-iphone-event-foldable-aapl-history-september-2026/)
- Recent level: the stock has traded around $315-320 since early September.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket appears to list weekly AAPL markets ("AAPL week September 11", "AAPL above in September 2026"). I only found them on unofficial mirror sites, and the odds there contradict each other, so I couldn't get usable prices. I found no market for 17 Sep specifically, and nothing on Kalshi or Manifold. [mirror](https://polymarket.technogab.duckdns.org/event/aapl-above-on-september-11-2026)
- Analyst targets: Morgan Stanley Overweight at $360, UBS Neutral at $296, BofA $370. The consensus is around $325, which is not a 1-week forecast. [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/aapl/forecast)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-11 (Fri): August CPI is released at 8:30 ET. [fedratecalc](https://fedratecalc.com/us-economic-calendar/)
- 2026-09-12: iPhone 18 Pro preorders open, according to one less-established recap site. Early reports on delivery lead times could move the stock. [stockmarkethours](https://stockmarkethours.org/events/apple-event)
- 2026-09-15/16: FOMC meeting, with the decision, new projections and press conference on 16 Sep. Pricing earlier in the summer put the chance of a 25bp **hike** at about 53-58% (target range stated as 3.50-3.75%). That makes this a significant macro risk the day before resolution. [Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2026-september.htm), [CoinGape](https://coingape.com/fomc-meeting-sept-2026-date-schedule-expectations-and-how-to-watch/)
- 2026-09-18: iPhone 18 Pro goes on sale, one day after the resolution date. [stockmarkethours](https://stockmarkethours.org/events/apple-event)
